CFML Language Reference: Functions

DatePart

Extracts a single part of a date/time value, selected by a datepart string.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DatePart(datepart, date)

Parameters

datepart
The part to return: yyyy year, q quarter (1-4), m month (1-12), y day of the year (1-366), d day of the month, w day of the week (1 = Sunday ... 7 = Saturday), ww week of the year (1-53), h hour (0-23), n minute, s second.
date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

Each datepart also has its own shortcut function: Year, Quarter, Month, DayOfYear, Day, DayOfWeek, Week, Hour, Minute and Second. Weeks start on Sunday, and week 1 is the week containing January 1. An unknown datepart throws an "Invalid date part" error.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET D = CreateDateTime(1999, 12, 31, 23, 59, 58)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Date: #D#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Datepart</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Part" LIST="yyyy,q,m,y,d,w,ww,h,n,s">
<TR><TD>#Part#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#DatePart(Part, D)#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

DateAdd, DateDiff, Year, DayOfWeek, Week
